summary: Interaction with other programs is byte-oriented, so pass bytes to subprocess; connection plugins' exec_command takes text and returns bytes, while higher-level helpers like _low_level_execute_command convert to text.
questions: Should subprocess get bytes or text in Ansible code?

answer_card.title: Interacting with other programs
answer_card.answer_md: OS interfaces are byte-oriented, so give `subprocess` bytes and expect bytes back. Connection plugins' `exec_command` converts commands to bytes and returns stdout/stderr as bytes; higher-level functions like `_low_level_execute_command` convert output to text.
